positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher - Detection of Musicality In Neural Activity
positions.description:
Music has a profound effect on our moods.  This project aimed to identify the influence of musical or non-musical audio on our neural activity to provide some insight into music therapy.  

• Generated features from electroencephalograph (EEG) data in MATLAB and performed binary classification on data samples using a Support Vector Machine
• Collaborated with teammates to design and execute Python experiments to perform live data presentation and collection
• Maintained a database of experimental and analytical results on GitHub via git

Environment: MATLAB

projects.title: Codible
projects.description:
This is a forum where Fullstack Developers (novices and experts, programmers and designers) can blog, document, and showcase their experiences.  There are several community groups through which users can interact via personal blogs and comments.  Within each of these communities, users can share their insights as they work on their development skills.  Through blog comments, experts can provide useful feedback for novice developers, and novices can ask expert developers clarifying questions.

Develop a full-stack web application to enhance collaborative learning and knowledge transfer among novice and expert web developers from different backgrounds via user-generated content
• Work with product designer and PM in an Agile setting to define and implement aesthetic and functional components
• Design and implement 5 models on the backend (users, community groups, blog posts, comments, and uploads) with
 CRUD operations and user-interface pages on the frontend
• Integrate authentication logic to allow individual users to manage their content
• Build a test suite of unit and integration tests to ensure quality and reduce the number of regressions

Environment: Python, Django, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, SQLite

projects.title: Detection of Maritime Sound-Emitting Objects from Audio
projects.description:
The US Coast Guard must occasionally handle hoax calls that expend resources and divert attention away from true emergency situations. Improving the methods and technology used in forensic investigations would provide law enforcement with more information while seeking the perpetrators. 

The ultimate goal of this project is to build a system to identify background entities for forensics investigators to use in conjunction with standard methods.

Audio is collected from publicly available datasets and analyzed for suitable transforms, then used to perform classification.

• Created an infrastructure to prepare, reformat, and process data, with a focus on code reusability and the capability to efficiently incorporate additional, newly-obtained data into the dataset
• Achieved an improved algorithm performance, as demonstrated by the quality of generated features and the performance of classifier models, by exploring several feature-generating methods
• Facilitated and documented meetings within an inter-disciplinary team to discuss and evaluate project requirements and monitor project quality while working with real-world, open-source data


Environment: Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Librosa
